audit: Juice improvement 2: enemy impact-local triangle hit reactions
summary: All scoped change gates pass using source review, actual native combat, sequential decoded MP4 impact detail, and event-isolated lifecycle observations. Local triangles preserve surrounding body detail without the inherited whole-body red wash on captured supported riflemen. Original mesh identity and balanced counters support expiry, ordinary gun death, controlled production cull, and ordinary leave_match cleanup. No production fix is required by this evidence.

fixes: No scoped production source fix required. Preserve the disclosed capture cadence, controlled cull fixture, source-provenance and review-coverage limits when publishing this decision.
